name: openGym
short_desc: Self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker with passkey login.
author: DuarteSantos8
description: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker: weekly routines over 5,600+ animated exercises, guided workouts, set logging, stats and PRs, installable PWA, offline sync and passkey sign-in. Your data stays in a folder you control.

form_fields.label: Public domain
form_fields.hint: Domain you reach openGym on, over HTTPS (e.g. through your reverse proxy). Passkeys are bound to it. Hostname only, no https:// and no port.
form_fields.pattern_error: Hostname only, without https:// or port.

form_fields.label: Default language
form_fields.hint: Language of the sign-in screen: en, fr, de, es, it, pt, pt-BR...
